official_pipeline.note: Retained as the cross-check reference, not retired. Bumping these commits invalidates every completed tier.

gigatoken_pipeline.commit_note: Adds the superbpe_stage1 scheme. Never bump without re-running scripts/compare_plan_a_trainers.py; bumping invalidates every completed tier.
notes: pretokenizer selects the stage-1 scheme. superbpe_stage1 is the official STAGE1_REGEX (o200k family, no contractions, \p{N}{1,3}); its letter classes include \p{M} so combining marks stay inside their letter run. The gigatoken default 'gpt2' excludes \p{M} and fragments hin_Deva, which inflates both its premium and its apparent superword gain.

separator is \n, not <|endoftext|>: gigatoken strips separator bytes and yields one document per line, matching the line units HuggingFace's trainer reads from the per-language files. The default separator would leave train.txt as a single document and forfeit pretokenization parallelism.

Stage 2 takes no regex. Units are bounded by separator, newline, and max_unit_len bytes, so superwords may bridge digits and punctuation that the official STAGE2_REGEX would split. This is a documented deviation: gigatoken's superword space is a strict superset of the official one.

max_balanced_corpus_note: Set by hat_Latn availability (~300 MB in FineWeb-2), the smallest of the six. Any tier whose bytes_per_language exceeds a language's available text must fail the build, not silently shrink.
projection_note: Runtime extrapolation constant only. Not an achievable balanced corpus for this language set; see max_balanced_corpus_bytes.
notes: Run tiers in order and stop after any OOM guard or failed verification.
Train both arms on the same corpus manifest before premium calibration.
corpus_bytes is derived: bytes_per_language * len(languages). Keep them consistent.

corpus_dir holds one .txt per language, not a single concatenated train.txt. The official trainer's get_files_with_num_bytes selects whole files, so a single sorted train.txt plus a --num-bytes below its size would train on a language prefix.
Pass --num-bytes as the exact corpus manifest total so no file is truncated and no file is repeated.
Runtime projections are linear estimates; memory must be measured at every tier.
The final scale tokenizer runs belong on measured high-memory AWS CPU jobs.
